title: finance.payroll.posted, schema_version 1
description: An approved payroll run, as one summarised journal: run totals only, never one person's pay. earnings + employer_contributions = income_tax + social_security + other_deductions + payable. Finance posts Dr Salaries and wages, Dr Employer social security; Cr PAYE, Social security payable, Other payroll deductions payable, Salaries payable, dated the last day of the period.

earnings_minor.description: Basic pay and allowances of everyone on the run.

employer_contributions_minor.description: The employer's social security, on top of earnings.

social_security_minor.description: Employee and employer shares together: what is owed to the fund.
